name: Volunteer with Parks
what_you_do: Help at parks and nature preserves. Work with kids in after school programs and teen programs, coach, and help at special events and clean ups.
who_can_apply: At least 16, or part of a pre approved group such as scouts or 4-H. You provide your own transportation.
deadline_text: The page lists separate volunteer forms for each type of work. It does not say when applications are taken.
how_to_apply: Pick the volunteer form that fits the park or role and send it in. To coach, contact the rec center directly.
notes: Scouts can use the Scout Project Application. Camp host applications for fall and winter 2026-27 will only be considered for spring and summer 2027.
